description: A script for managing benchmarking workflows, including command generation, log parsing, report generation, and dashboard updates for PyTorch performance benchmarks.

classes.name: Parser
classes.description: Base class for parsing benchmark logs, providing methods to check headers.

classes.name: ParsePerformanceLogs
classes.description: Subclass of Parser that extracts and processes performance benchmark data, generates plots, and reports.

classes.name: LogInfo
classes.description: Dataclass holding log date and directory path information.

classes.name: SummaryStatDiffer
classes.description: Class for comparing recent benchmark summaries to detect changes.

classes.name: RegressionDetector
classes.description: Class for identifying regressions between recent benchmark runs.

classes.name: RegressionTracker
classes.description: Class for plotting metrics over time to monitor regressions.

classes.name: DashboardUpdater
classes.description: Class for updating and posting benchmark reports and images to the performance dashboard.

methods.name: parse_args
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments for benchmarking workflow control.

methods.name: get_mode
methods.description: Determines whether the mode is 'training' or 'inference' based on args.

methods.name: get_skip_tests
methods.description: Generates skip test flags based on suite, device, and mode.

methods.name: generate_csv_name
methods.description: Creates a filename for CSV output based on parameters.

methods.name: generate_commands
methods.description: Generates shell script with commands to run benchmarks.

methods.name: generate_dropdown_comment
methods.description: Creates a markdown dropdown comment with a title and body.

methods.name: build_summary
methods.description: Builds a summary of the current code state, environment, and hardware info.

methods.name: archive_data
methods.description: Generates a date-based archive name for logs.

methods.name: default_archive_name
methods.description: Creates a default archive name with date and random suffix.

methods.name: get_archive_name
methods.description: Returns the archive name, either default or specified.

methods.name: archive
methods.description: Copies logs to an archive directory.

methods.name: get_metric_title
methods.description: Returns human-readable title for a metric.

methods.name: parse_logs
methods.description: Parses benchmark logs and generates reports.
